result.title: Beyond Static Structures: Linking Protein Dynamics to Function via DynaReason-Pro
result.summary: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) carry out their functions through heterogeneous conformational ensembles that reflect their dynamics, yet most protein function prediction methods rely on sequence or a single static structure. To this end, we introduce DynaReason-Pro, the first framework to jointly predict GO terms from conformational ensembles and generate natural-language functional rationales. We evaluate DynaReason-Pro on a curated IDP benchmark from the Protein Ensemble Database (PED), with sequence- and structure-cluster-disjoint splits to prevent data leakage. Variability-stratified evaluation shows the clearest gains in the high-conformational-variability regime.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 DynaReason-Pro，从蛋白质构象集合直接预测 GO 功能条目，并同时生成自然语言的功能依据，在基于 PED 的 IDP 基准上以序列与结构簇不相交划分和按构象变异性分层的方式评估，报告高变异性区段收益最明显。
AI.relevance_reason: 把构象集合当作分布式的内部状态表示、并据此筛选证据生成解释，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的聚合与视觉证据筛选、以及按不确定性分层的评测设计形成概念类比，可供核查其集合信息如何被压缩使用；该文并非多模态推理工作。
